newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco Itau buys Bamerindus' Europe branch.
newsitem.headline: Banco Itau buys Bamerindus' Europe branch.

text.p: Brazilian private bank Banco Itau has acquired the European branch of failed Banco Bamerindus in Luxembourg to strenghten its private banking activities in the region, said a top bank executive.

Itau, which already has a European subsidiary based in Portugal called Itau Europa, bought the Luxembourg branch for about 10 million reais, said Alfredo Setubal, executive vice-president at the bank.

Bamerindus' branch in Luxembourg is one of the three bank units abroad that were not acquired by HSBC Holdings Plc when it took over selected assets and liabilities of Brazil's fourth-largest private bank Banco Bamerindus early this year.
Bamerindus also has branches in New York and London, which are now under Central Bank administration.

Setubal said the bank in the future aims to close Itau Europa's own branch in Luxembourg and transfer control of the Bamerindus unit to its European subsidiary. He said the new branch gives Itau a larger client base in Luxembourg.
"The branch was acquired by Banco Itau, but the idea is to transfer it to Itau Europa's control," he said.
Itau Europa began operations in October 1994. It ended 1996 with $639 million in assets, $116 million in net worth and a net profit of $6.6 million.
Setubal also said Itau has 120 days to finalize details on the deal with the Central Bank.
